record_kind: dated development evaluation; excluded from default retrieval
source_scope: Pre-rewrite checkpoint plus the documentation/tooling working tree identified by these hashes; documentation evaluation does not execute or certify the simulation.
reviewer: Codex retrieval-evaluation subagent; source-backed semantic review, not blind or independently human graded
rubric: Manual review of all top-five contexts against the frozen source-backed expected facts. Sufficient requires all material expected facts and their status/platform qualifications within retrieved text; links alone do not supply omitted facts. Partial supplies some but not all; insufficient omits the main answer. No downstream model generation or embedding system was tested.
review_procedure: All top-five contexts were reviewed against the frozen expected facts; unchanged contexts reused the completed first-candidate review and every changed context was reread. All material facts and status/platform qualifications must be present in retrieved text. A link does not supply an omitted fact.
limitations: Development questions and expected facts were frozen before rewriting but disclosed to editors; refinements used these results. This is not held-out generalization.
A single lexical heading/BM25 configuration was tested. No embeddings, hybrid retriever, reranker or downstream answer generation was evaluated.
Canonical route metrics identify an allowed page among the first five chunks, not necessarily the complete answer. Manual sufficiency is scored separately.

Historical-substitution zero means none of the reviewed contexts explicitly represented a historical platform result as a fresh current-platform pass. It does not prove arbitrary answer generators cannot misuse a historical passage.
The rewrite changed corpus membership, status metadata, heading structure and wording together; these results do not isolate their individual causal effects.
All contexts were reviewed by the collaborating Codex evaluator, not a blind independent human panel.
Raw byte hashes include captured line endings. Markdown is normalized before scoring; Git LF versus captured CRLF can differ in raw hash while yielding identical chunks.

results.query: Will frozen offscreen sand resume automatically when the camera moves back, including the serial reference backend?
expected_facts: Phased native region filtering can exclude active blocks while quiet/sleep accounting continues, so excluded blocks can sleep.
Changing or clearing the simulation region does not wake those sleeping blocks; they may need a separate external wake to resume.
SerialInPlace does not apply the same region filter. Intended re-entry behavior requires an explicit implementation decision and regression coverage.
